_about: One definition of 'is this surface asking the person to choose?', shared by the runtime (runtime/app/fork.js::isDecisionDialog) and the compiler (conxa_compile/compiler/outcome_fork.py::classify_dialog). Both test suites load this file, so the two implementations cannot drift. A surface is a decision only when it has no input fields, is not a native dialog, is not a cookie/consent banner, has two or more buttons, and those buttons are not all plain dismiss labels. Anything else -- a toast, a progress panel, a lone Cancel -- is not.
